# AXM Workshop v0.6.1 Experimental

This is a **corrective integrity prerelease** built from one exact reviewed merge commit.

## What this corrects

- Resumable Game Production Runner state, ledgers, checkpoints, and portable receipts now use no-follow, regular-file-checked atomic I/O.
- Hardware research packages now enforce exact authority, boundary, package, and record shapes, including deliberately re-digested inputs.
- Compute-root state is deterministically replayed from the protected known start through every exact proposal and human-steward decision.
- RepairBuddy strict warning deltas invoke a fresh root verification and use more stable structured warning identities.
- The Deterministic PR Publisher now states its truth: its confirmation is a static exact phrase, not a consumed nonce. Repository-local Git hooks are disabled for the bounded push, and receiver verification requires the PR to remain draft.

## Release evidence attached

- AXM-named Windows source package;
- SHA-256 checksum;
- public packager and restore receipts;
- exact extracted-package Windows launch receipt;
- release asset inventory;
- source-gate receipt and root verifier report;
- RepairBuddy warning-delta receipt;
- GitHub release receiver receipt.

## Preserved boundaries

This remains experimental. It is not production certification, safety certification, automatic promotion, procurement, deployment, roots authority, CANON authority, or a broad reuse license. The package does not bundle Node.js; first Windows launch requires internet when no compatible Node.js is already available.

Repository settings are a separate administration gate. Their state is reported independently rather than inferred from this source release.
